pages.title: Magnetar Crust Fragment
pages.text: Iron crust from a magnetar, under a field of 10¹¹ tesla. It cracks in starquakes - and it still bends compass needles from across a room.

Made in $(item)Pulsed Magnet Lab$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Magnetar Crust Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Pulsar Beacon chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Magnetars.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Disk Confinement Ring, Magnetic Monopole, Magnetite.
